notes.title: Crafting a Dark, Beautiful World: Inside ASTHENIA with Manthos Lappas
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yTnm5z-R5Fs;full][/previewyoutube]

I had the pleasure of talking with John Leon on his YouTube channel, DevDungeon, about my game.

We are discussing how it all started, my debut in gamedev, the technical difficulties and challenges along the way, hacking my way through making a game with no previous experience other than having worked in the gaming industry as a concept artist. 

I am also talking about my inspirations behind ASTHENIA, both from real life events and other media that influenced me. Discussing publishers, creating the sound in the game and much much more!
Including a hint on estimated release date! :)

[b]Demo progress: [/b] 
I am working endlessly and hard to polish the demo and fix various issues arising, with the help of my programmer. I strive to bring you a well-polished demo, as much as possible given my limitations and experience. Thank you for your patience and interest!

-Manthos

notes.title: Game (and Demo) progress Update - Other News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

This is another update on the current progress of my game. 

[b]LIFE STUFF[/b]

My co-dev and I are actively working on the demo. Lots of challenges, and unexpected stuff to resolve but also delays given our busy work schedules. However, rest assured we do our best possible.

I had a surgery that went well and I am now in a recovery period as well.
We have been also in talks with our voice actor who unfortunately got caught in the LA wildfires, which means our recording sessions seem to be pushed back - we will keep everyone posted on that. We hope for everyone who suffered this disaster to be well.

[b]OTHER GAME NEWS AND PROGRESS
[/b]
I am working on updating some older assets that I had created for the game, years ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/10ff64317ce53b9b83d16606fcc4ed360a9faa20.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/640ae89b3b60f283a4b08806230409535e7526a2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/1dba75a73f16f5fb88e9378b2b5293d59461446a.jpg[/img]

As primarily an Artist in the industry, I have a special soft spot for putting as much attention and care in my game assets as possible. Thus, I felt the need to update quite a lot of them to match my current vision and look for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/c21cae4fe095f43248439d5ae11e027f42edd613.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTROLLER SUPPORT AND INPUTS REMAP[/b]

My co-dev is working on implementing remap options as well as full controller support. Excited to see how all that turns out! UE4 is giving us some hard time and challenges with that system but we are optimistic that should be fine in the end.

[b]OPTIMIZATIONS [/b]

We are now a team of 2 core devs. While we have no prior experience in shipped games or Unreal (and limited resources in our hands) We are doing our best in our knowledge and understanding to optimize the game code and graphics-wise. Especially on the latter, I am working on any method possible to have this game run well on older machines as well. (No need for fancy or expensive rigs is my goal)

[previewyoutube=dBreE6-ABd0;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=0UwrzJoHVTM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]UPDATED SOUNDS AND MUSIC[/b]

I am also working on updating/ improving the sound design as well as some of the tracks in the game.
Some small preview: 
https://www.bandlab.com/matthaiosgreekost/collections/c4f84f3e-3786-ee11-b75e-000d3a428fff


[previewyoutube=fJSsyz0aLCU;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=SmN-qdZMQJE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MORE ART AND STORY STUFF[/b]

I have been also putting a lot of effort and time into updating everything lore-wise in the demo (and beyond). Paintings with story bits, clues, as well new letters to find in the decayed world of Asthenia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/75ab30ff142cea1834a6118f8fe045978883436e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/bd7b971770f5190942ba68e669d29bf44668cb90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/f0da851f06ad4bd3aadcc2101b722a6ca8b318e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/307af91011d017b35f33b0bf4b65370ab23881d6.png[/img]


Thank you for reading this update and for your support. Please stay tuned for any news and updates on Asthenia, and consider Wishlisting the game if you are interested, it does help a lot!

-Manthos

notes.title: Demo in progress - Voice Actor casting - & Other game Updates
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It's been a while since I posted any news here, as the majority of updates happen on the basis on my social media.
Been very busy focused on the demo as well as the game as a whole.
I am excited to share with you that there is a lot of progress on the [b]demo[/b] made so far!

My Co-Dev and I are working on it daily and there are so many new additions that I wouldn't even dream of without his help. Let's see a few of those!

[b]UPDATED UI & SETTINGS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/c9ac000cb830bc3227ff975be95f99ca2434b17e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/2eebc8f05c717701d34fd5138ef79b7feee6f25d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/2628eb178ace933fbd2a87426aaba9c5401d9da6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/a4f6754ab3a5a70e71d107c8f6cc11f8c855a558.png[/img]

[b]GAME SAVE SLOTS[/b]

The Co-Dev has introduced the save slots system and refining it. Excited to have such a feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/a877ed08d2b64581209978dd047f76b7ffaaeadd.png[/img]
I have been trying to keep consistency for the art style in-game and those UI elements and present a unified look.

[b]SCRIPT FOR DEMO COMPLETED[/b]

I am thrilled to announce that the writing/ script for the demo has been completed. That contains Protagonist lines, journals, letters, and notes found in the world left by its inhabitants, and others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/3ff4c0aca6432601027b41b8908c72d2ebd3c9dd.jpg[/img]

The letters left by those who live or lived in this world will be scattered around and for those of you who enjoy exploring and discovering, I hope you gonna like it!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/6ed31064ae54a7e4b6d678bb20b0a25a2afc421c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/bdd559bcc22cfdfebbe92cadca03fd1c9735d36d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/e4bb13f65b1989696b2bd549d77d2cd0cad9ca6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/3d40eebc1ccf69084c8c0105b4f4b7191a45983d.png[/img]

[b]SECRET LORE, HINTS, OVERALL STORY LETTERS![/b]

One of my very old ideas and plans was to introduce the feature of secret letters that serve as a guide of what to "expect" or avoid doing in the game in order to potentially alter your story's ending. Some hints, if you may. Also, I always wanted to give more personality to my foes, and for that, I decided to create special notes left by them in the world that can be revealed when you defeat them! (if you choose to).

This will hopefully result in having a better understanding of what really happened to them and how they dealt with their own personal stories and events throughout the game.

[b]LOOK OUT FOR THOSE:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/efebcc8a2c351995647d0fa9995b5fee9bd99f80.png[/img]

[b]MORE UPDATES ON UI TUTORIALS AND OTHER WIDGETS
[/b]
[u](In-Editor Preview-Work in progress)[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/b4998c15097a8df42822ea95340d5feefa6304ca.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/5320d6763ae0f817f53425c224102f68bd8a0401.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/9a8273ba19bbece513d75fc230eeab20f5138ffb.png[/img]

[b]VOICE ACTOR FOR MAIN PROTAGONIST[/b]

For a long time, I have been on the search for someone to lend their voice to our protagonist.
Recently I got back in contact with one of the VA's who I really liked but was in a situation where I could not afford anyone for a long time. Long story short, We are now in talks with the Actor who is a known one, an incredibly friendly and wonderful person aside from a talented Voice Actor who delivers with passion and charm! While I cannot say more at the moment, I am extremely excited to share any updates with you all soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/bfb58e1e978d1b812feb28c9e6e4a5a5e8a52d9a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/3a7a97559e6ea9eb1154b5fc6dc473b88b9564df.png[/img]

Please consider wishlisting Asthenia while we work on the demo! The support means everything to us, as this is my debut game and a very personal one.

Thank you for reading this update, and for your support, and I wish you guys a Merry Christmas with your loved ones and a Happy New Year!

[b]-Manthos[/b]

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer, Co-Dev, Demo, and other Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I have recently updated my Steam page with a [b]brand-new game trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=j_Xbz16FCJ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, After some feedback on the [b]"About"[/b] section, I have also added a few more GIFs that show gameplay.
Additionally, here are a few more [b]Gameplay[/b] clips:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/b0aff4831d2ca79f3b1a555242238750f6951407.gif[/img]

This shows how the player can heal using the child statues holding the blue flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/468f8c92fcaf4aef014a564c4875205f69b3f6c3.gif[/img]

The Guardians help you later in the game by assisting you in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/cc86d3c1c5c8aac91c482c2258b623b50aec99e3.gif[/img]

There are alternative ways even to combat the enemies using some special artifact(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/ea24a059a4019234927b0b9f5539d78dbc2025bc.gif[/img]

The Gauntlet has another secret special feature that can deal even greater damage to enemies gathered together.

[b]New Co-Dev[/b]

For those 5 years I have been developing the game, I have been doing it completely alone without any experience as a dev before that. Which has led to endless frustrations, issues, and other critical problems. 

That said, Recently I was lucky and delighted to reconnect with an old friend from abroad, Quentin Stainer, who happened to be one of my very old clients in the times I used to do art. He is a great guy and a very skilled programmer who was truly excited and passionate about joining Asthenia's production! Something that came as an invaluable moment to me.
Fast forward to today, we are now both working on the game and Quentin is dedicated to the Coding part, picking up from where I left off, as, while my messy code worked, it has not been the most optimal one, to put simply.

Also, Quentin will be helping me by bringing in the game more and extra accessibility options that were missing! As well, as more stuff and overall improvements! We will be keeping people updated on our social media (Mainly X) and announcements here. I am more than honored, humbled, and excited to have Quentin onboard, Thank you for that, and truly eager to see what we can achieve together! Welcome! :) 

[b]DEMO[/b]

We have actively started working on a demo version. I'm focusing on art stuff and assets, as well as writing /script while Quentin will be handling the programming parts. We Will keep everyone updated with the progress but please mind that the demo might only be ready sometime early next year if all goes smoothly. 

[b]Some extra GIFs for you![/b]

Thank you once again for your support, everyone! We are working hard to make this the best we can!

Stay Tuned!

[b]-Manthos[/b]

notes.title: ASTHENIA--The Atmosphere of the World--Preview
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

First of all, I wish to kindly Thank you for your support and wishlisting my game! It means so much and I am excited and eager to share more content and other updates with you!

I have started re-posting/ uploading some videos that show more of the game's world, in it's current state and some of the stuff you can experience. 

[previewyoutube=admoA9wr5RM;full][/previewyoutube]

I emphasize world-building through environment visual details, architecture, hints via certain objects, and even metaphorical and symbolic items. 

[previewyoutube=yDhMuCvuNVI;full][/previewyoutube]


Sound plays a huge role in the game and the immersion of the player, thus, I am trying to add a variety of sounds and ambience to create a rich environment with interesting, and even hidden cues throughout the game. 


[previewyoutube=iGlYzHGeOfk;full][/previewyoutube]

And here are some images from the early areas:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/6fbb41c445f2855426da4c1a1c2dd72205c54207.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/61139819ce52aad18c6b673d97adcfc5b8ce7dfb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/75735080fea971bfffb0c51046544f0968e24b3d.png[/img]
These statues serve as points to replenish lost HP. As long the flames burn, you can restore health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/f13f3ee2ed702877cd6b32d758d888c4d045a593.png[/img]
This is an early preview of how some of the scattered journals will appear/look like. Please note, this is a work in progress- errors will be corrected. Those will also serve as hints in the world, to either solve secrets or access hidden areas and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/4785b30fe32d5154b8d6c81c229c5228b14b8c4b.png[/img]
You will be able to find more notes around such points and many of those will be crucial to the story/ lore information and other hints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190756/d8201ae7740a38af9d23e55d619a6fd9b410fef4.png[/img]
I'm working on presenting a world rich in details that directly or indirectly imply events, and other story bits. Or even offer help/guidance often, 

I will be gradually posting more stuff to help you guys get a better idea of what to expect, while we are working on a demo. I will be posting any news and updates!

Once again, Thanks for the support!
Please feel welcome to write what you think!

-Manthos
